detail: Scheme of Arrangement - The Board of Directors of Somany Ceramics Limited at their meeting held today i.e. 13th July, 2026, has, inter-alia, considered and approved an additional investment of up to Rs. 15.00 crore in M/s. Sudha Somany Ceramics Private Limited, a subsidiary of the Company, by way of subscription to equity shares and/or preference shares, in one or more tranches.
